new_years_day: JANUARY IS NAMED FOR JANUS, THE ROMAN GOD OF DOORWAYS AND BEGINNINGS.
JULIUS CAESAR'S CALENDAR MADE JANUARY 1 THE START OF THE YEAR IN 45 BC.
THE FIRST ROSE PARADE ROLLED THROUGH PASADENA ON JANUARY 1, 1890.
THE FIRST ROSE BOWL GAME WAS PLAYED IN 1902. MICHIGAN BEAT STANFORD 49-0.
"AULD LANG SYNE" MEANS "OLD LONG SINCE" - ROUGHLY, "FOR OLD TIMES' SAKE."
ROBERT BURNS WROTE DOWN THE WORDS TO "AULD LANG SYNE" IN 1788.
IN THE AMERICAN SOUTH, BLACK-EYED PEAS ON NEW YEAR'S DAY ARE SAID TO BRING GOOD LUCK.
IN SPAIN, PEOPLE EAT 12 GRAPES AT MIDNIGHT - ONE FOR EACH CHIME OF THE CLOCK.
ANCIENT BABYLONIANS MADE NEW YEAR'S PROMISES TO THEIR GODS ABOUT 4,000 YEARS AGO.
THE BABYLONIAN NEW YEAR BEGAN IN SPRING, NOT IN THE MIDDLE OF WINTER.
BRITAIN AND ITS AMERICAN COLONIES DID NOT START THE YEAR ON JANUARY 1 UNTIL 1752.
THE NHL'S FIRST WINTER CLASSIC WAS PLAYED OUTDOORS IN BUFFALO ON JANUARY 1, 2008.
WRIGLEY FIELD HOSTED THE NHL WINTER CLASSIC ON NEW YEAR'S DAY 2009.
NEW YEAR'S DAY BECAME A U.S. FEDERAL HOLIDAY IN 1870.
IN JAPAN, TEMPLE BELLS RING 108 TIMES TO WELCOME THE NEW YEAR.
IN SCOTLAND, THE FIRST VISITOR OF THE NEW YEAR IS CALLED THE "FIRST-FOOTER."
KIRIBATI'S LINE ISLANDS ARE AMONG THE FIRST PLACES ON EARTH TO SEE THE NEW YEAR.
groundhog_day: PUNXSUTAWNEY, PENNSYLVANIA HELD ITS FIRST GROUNDHOG DAY IN 1887.
PUNXSUTAWNEY PHIL MAKES HIS FORECAST AT A SPOT CALLED GOBBLER'S KNOB.
IF THE GROUNDHOG SEES HIS SHADOW, LEGEND SAYS SIX MORE WEEKS OF WINTER.
NO SHADOW MEANS AN EARLY SPRING, ACCORDING TO THE LEGEND.
GROUNDHOGS ARE ALSO CALLED WOODCHUCKS AND WHISTLE-PIGS.
A GROUNDHOG IS A KIND OF LARGE GROUND SQUIRREL CALLED A MARMOT.
GROUNDHOGS ARE TRUE HIBERNATORS. THEIR HEARTBEAT SLOWS TO ABOUT 5 BEATS A MINUTE.
THE TRADITION CAME FROM GERMAN SETTLERS, WHO WATCHED A BADGER OR HEDGEHOG BACK HOME.
FEBRUARY 2 IS ALSO CANDLEMAS, ABOUT HALFWAY BETWEEN THE START OF WINTER AND SPRING.
THE 1993 MOVIE "GROUNDHOG DAY" WAS FILMED IN WOODSTOCK, ILLINOIS.
WOODSTOCK, ILLINOIS STILL HOLDS A GROUNDHOG DAYS FESTIVAL EVERY YEAR.
PHIL'S HANDLERS WEAR TOP HATS AND ARE KNOWN AS THE INNER CIRCLE.
WEATHER RECORDS SHOW PHIL HAS BEEN RIGHT LESS THAN HALF THE TIME.
A GROUNDHOG CAN MOVE HUNDREDS OF POUNDS OF DIRT DIGGING A SINGLE BURROW.
GROUNDHOG BURROWS HAVE SEPARATE ROOMS, INCLUDING A BATHROOM.
STATEN ISLAND CHUCK AND GENERAL BEAUREGARD LEE ARE RIVAL GROUNDHOG FORECASTERS.
THE NAME WOODCHUCK COMES FROM AN ALGONQUIAN WORD, NOT FROM CHUCKING WOOD.
valentines_day: ESTHER HOWLAND SOLD THE FIRST MASS-PRODUCED AMERICAN VALENTINES IN THE 1840S.
RICHARD CADBURY SOLD THE FIRST HEART-SHAPED BOX OF CHOCOLATES IN THE 1860S.
CONVERSATION HEARTS CANDIES WERE FIRST MADE BY NECCO IN THE EARLY 1900S.
THE OLDEST KNOWN VALENTINE WAS WRITTEN IN 1415 BY A DUKE HELD IN THE TOWER OF LONDON.
GEOFFREY CHAUCER WAS ONE OF THE FIRST TO LINK ST. VALENTINE'S DAY WITH ROMANCE.
CUPID WAS THE ROMAN GOD OF LOVE. THE GREEKS CALLED HIM EROS.
HALLMARK BEGAN OFFERING VALENTINE'S DAY CARDS IN 1913.
"WEARING YOUR HEART ON YOUR SLEEVE" COMES FROM SHAKESPEARE'S "OTHELLO."
THE RED ROSE WAS SACRED TO VENUS, THE ROMAN GODDESS OF LOVE.
IN JAPAN, WOMEN GIVE CHOCOLATE ON FEBRUARY 14 AND MEN RETURN THE FAVOR ON MARCH 14.
IN FINLAND, FEBRUARY 14 IS FRIEND'S DAY, A DAY TO CELEBRATE FRIENDSHIP.
THE LETTER X HAS STOOD FOR A KISS IN LETTERS FOR HUNDREDS OF YEARS.
VERONA, ITALY GETS THOUSANDS OF LETTERS ADDRESSED TO JULIET EVERY YEAR.
THE HEART SHAPE HAS BEEN A SYMBOL OF LOVE SINCE THE MIDDLE AGES.
LOVEBIRDS ARE SMALL PARROTS THAT FORM STRONG, LIFELONG PAIR BONDS.
LOVELAND, COLORADO RE-MAILS THOUSANDS OF VALENTINES A YEAR WITH A SPECIAL POSTMARK.
MORE THAN ONE EARLY CHRISTIAN MARTYR WAS NAMED VALENTINE.
st_patricks_day: ST. PATRICK WAS BORN IN ROMAN BRITAIN, NOT IN IRELAND.
AS A TEENAGER, PATRICK WAS KIDNAPPED BY RAIDERS AND TAKEN TO IRELAND AS A SLAVE.
PATRICK ESCAPED AFTER SIX YEARS, THEN LATER RETURNED TO IRELAND AS A MISSIONARY.
LEGEND SAYS PATRICK USED A THREE-LEAF SHAMROCK TO EXPLAIN THE TRINITY.
CHICAGO HAS DYED ITS RIVER GREEN FOR ST. PATRICK'S DAY SINCE 1962.
THE DYE THAT TURNS THE CHICAGO RIVER GREEN STARTS OUT AS AN ORANGE POWDER.
THE COLOR FIRST LINKED TO ST. PATRICK WAS BLUE, NOT GREEN.
IRELAND HAS NEVER HAD SNAKES. THE STORY OF PATRICK DRIVING THEM OUT IS A LEGEND.
MARCH 17 IS THE DATE ST. PATRICK IS BELIEVED TO HAVE DIED, AROUND THE YEAR 461.
NEW YORK CITY'S ST. PATRICK'S DAY PARADE DATES BACK TO 1762.
A SHAMROCK HAS THREE LEAVES. A FOUR-LEAF CLOVER IS A RARE LUCKY FIND.
CORNED BEEF AND CABBAGE BECAME THE HOLIDAY MEAL IN AMERICA, NOT IN IRELAND.
THE HARP, NOT THE SHAMROCK, IS THE OFFICIAL SYMBOL OF IRELAND.
IN IRISH FOLKLORE, LEPRECHAUNS ARE SHOEMAKERS WHO HIDE THEIR GOLD.
ST. PATRICK'S DAY IS A PUBLIC HOLIDAY IN IRELAND AND ON THE ISLAND OF MONTSERRAT.
PATRICK TOLD HIS OWN STORY IN A SHORT BOOK CALLED THE "CONFESSION."
palm_sunday: PALM SUNDAY MARKS JESUS' ENTRY INTO JERUSALEM, ONE WEEK BEFORE EASTER.
ALL FOUR GOSPELS TELL OF JESUS ENTERING JERUSALEM.
JESUS RODE INTO JERUSALEM ON A YOUNG DONKEY, A SIGN OF PEACE AND HUMILITY.
ZECHARIAH 9:9 FORETOLD A HUMBLE KING ARRIVING ON A DONKEY.
THE CROWDS SPREAD CLOAKS AND BRANCHES ON THE ROAD BEFORE JESUS.
ONLY THE GOSPEL OF JOHN SAYS THE BRANCHES WERE PALMS.
THE CROWD SHOUTED "HOSANNA," A HEBREW WORD MEANING "SAVE US, WE PRAY."
THE SHOUT "BLESSED IS HE WHO COMES IN THE NAME OF THE LORD" IS FROM PSALM 118.
PALM SUNDAY BEGINS HOLY WEEK, THE LAST WEEK OF LENT.
JESUS BEGAN HIS RIDE NEAR THE MOUNT OF OLIVES, JUST EAST OF JERUSALEM.
THE GOSPEL OF LUKE SAYS JESUS WEPT OVER JERUSALEM AS HE DREW NEAR THE CITY.
IN THE ANCIENT WORLD, PALM BRANCHES WERE A SYMBOL OF VICTORY.
MANY CHURCHES BURN THIS YEAR'S PALMS TO MAKE ASHES FOR NEXT YEAR'S ASH WEDNESDAY.
PEOPLE OFTEN FOLD THEIR PALM BRANCHES INTO SMALL CROSSES.
A PILGRIM NAMED EGERIA DESCRIBED A PALM PROCESSION IN JERUSALEM IN THE 300S.
WHEN TOLD TO QUIET THE CROWD, JESUS SAID THE VERY STONES WOULD CRY OUT.
WHERE PALMS DO NOT GROW, CHURCHES HAVE USED WILLOW, OLIVE OR YEW BRANCHES INSTEAD.
good_friday: GOOD FRIDAY REMEMBERS THE CRUCIFIXION OF JESUS.
ALL FOUR GOSPELS GIVE AN ACCOUNT OF THE CRUCIFIXION.
JESUS WAS CRUCIFIED AT GOLGOTHA, WHICH MEANS "THE PLACE OF THE SKULL."
THE NAME CALVARY COMES FROM THE LATIN WORD FOR SKULL.
THE SIGN ON THE CROSS WAS WRITTEN IN HEBREW, LATIN AND GREEK.
THE LETTERS INRI STAND FOR THE LATIN WORDS "JESUS OF NAZARETH, KING OF THE JEWS."
THE GOSPELS RECORD SEVEN SAYINGS OF JESUS FROM THE CROSS.
DARKNESS COVERED THE LAND FROM NOON UNTIL THREE IN THE AFTERNOON.
THE TEMPLE CURTAIN WAS TORN IN TWO FROM TOP TO BOTTOM.
SIMON OF CYRENE WAS MADE TO CARRY THE CROSS.
JOSEPH OF ARIMATHEA LAID JESUS' BODY IN HIS OWN NEW TOMB.
ISAIAH 53 SPEAKS OF A SERVANT WHO SUFFERS FOR THE SINS OF MANY.
MANY CHURCHES HOLD SERVICES FROM NOON TO THREE, THE HOURS OF DARKNESS AT THE CROSS.
MANY SCHOLARS THINK THE "GOOD" IN GOOD FRIDAY ONCE MEANT "HOLY."
IN GERMAN, THE DAY IS CALLED KARFREITAG, MEANING "FRIDAY OF MOURNING."
JOHN 3:16 - "FOR GOD SO LOVED THE WORLD, THAT HE GAVE HIS ONLY BEGOTTEN SON."
A ROMAN CENTURION AT THE CROSS SAID, "TRULY THIS MAN WAS THE SON OF GOD."
THE STATIONS OF THE CROSS FOLLOW JESUS' PATH TO CALVARY IN 14 STEPS.
easter: EASTER CELEBRATES THE RESURRECTION OF JESUS ON THE THIRD DAY AFTER THE CRUCIFIXION.
THE WOMEN WHO CAME TO THE TOMB AT DAWN FOUND THE STONE ROLLED AWAY.
THE ANGEL AT THE TOMB SAID, "HE IS NOT HERE: FOR HE IS RISEN."
MARY MAGDALENE WAS THE FIRST TO SEE THE RISEN JESUS.
THE RISEN JESUS WALKED WITH TWO DISCIPLES ON THE ROAD TO EMMAUS.
EASTER FALLS ON THE FIRST SUNDAY AFTER THE FIRST FULL MOON OF SPRING.
EASTER CAN FALL AS EARLY AS MARCH 22 AND AS LATE AS APRIL 25.
THE COUNCIL OF NICAEA SET THE RULE FOR DATING EASTER IN THE YEAR 325.
THE GREETING "HE IS RISEN" IS ANSWERED WITH "HE IS RISEN INDEED."
MANY CHURCHES GREET EASTER MORNING WITH A SERVICE AT SUNRISE.
THE FIRST RECORDED EASTER SUNRISE SERVICE WAS HELD BY MORAVIANS IN GERMANY IN 1732.
THE 40 DAYS OF LENT LEAD UP TO EASTER.
EGGS ARE AN ANCIENT SYMBOL OF NEW LIFE.
THE EASTER BUNNY CAME TO AMERICA WITH GERMAN SETTLERS IN THE 1700S.
THE WHITE HOUSE EASTER EGG ROLL BEGAN IN 1878.
THE EASTER LILY IS NATIVE TO JAPAN.
HOT CROSS BUNS ARE MARKED WITH A CROSS AND TRADITIONALLY EATEN ON GOOD FRIDAY.
PEEPS MARSHMALLOW CHICKS HAVE BEEN MADE IN BETHLEHEM, PENNSYLVANIA SINCE 1953.
april_fools: NO ONE KNOWS FOR SURE HOW APRIL FOOLS' DAY BEGAN.
IN FRANCE, AN APRIL FOOLS' PRANK IS CALLED AN "APRIL FISH."
FRENCH CHILDREN TAPE PAPER FISH TO EACH OTHER'S BACKS ON APRIL 1.
IN 1957, THE BBC AIRED A PRANK REPORT ABOUT SPAGHETTI GROWING ON TREES.
IN 1996, TACO BELL JOKED THAT IT HAD BOUGHT THE LIBERTY BELL.
IN 1998, BURGER KING ADVERTISED A "LEFT-HANDED WHOPPER."
IN SCOTLAND, A PRANK VICTIM WAS CALLED A "GOWK," A WORD FOR THE CUCKOO.
IN 1962, A SWEDISH TV PRANK SAID A NYLON STOCKING WOULD TURN A SCREEN TO COLOR.
IN 1985, SPORTS ILLUSTRATED INVENTED SIDD FINCH, A PITCHER WITH A 168 MPH FASTBALL.
BRITISH TRADITION SAYS PRANKS SHOULD STOP AT NOON.
GMAIL LAUNCHED ON APRIL 1, 2004, AND MANY PEOPLE THOUGHT IT WAS A JOKE.
IN 2008, THE BBC SHOWED "FLYING PENGUINS" IN AN APRIL FOOLS' FILM.
IN 1698, LONDONERS WERE INVITED TO SEE "THE WASHING OF THE LIONS" AT THE TOWER.
A CLASSIC OLD PRANK IS SENDING SOMEONE ON A "FOOL'S ERRAND."
IN 1976, A BBC RADIO PRANK SAID GRAVITY WOULD WEAKEN FOR A MOMENT.
A JESTER'S FLOPPY HAT WITH BELLS IS CALLED A "CAP AND BELLS."
THE EARLIEST CLEAR MENTION OF APRIL 1 PRANKS IS A FLEMISH POEM FROM 1561.
earth_day: THE FIRST EARTH DAY WAS APRIL 22, 1970.
SENATOR GAYLORD NELSON OF WISCONSIN FOUNDED EARTH DAY.
ABOUT 20 MILLION AMERICANS TOOK PART IN THE FIRST EARTH DAY.
THE ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY WAS CREATED LATER THAT SAME YEAR, 1970.
ABOUT 71 PERCENT OF EARTH'S SURFACE IS COVERED BY WATER.
EARTH IS ABOUT 4.5 BILLION YEARS OLD.
EARTH IS THE ONLY PLANET NOT NAMED FOR A GREEK OR ROMAN GOD.
THE "BLUE MARBLE" PHOTO OF EARTH WAS TAKEN BY THE APOLLO 17 CREW IN 1972.
RECYCLING ALUMINUM USES ABOUT 95 PERCENT LESS ENERGY THAN MAKING IT NEW.
A SINGLE LARGE OAK TREE CAN DROP THOUSANDS OF ACORNS IN A GOOD YEAR.
THE AMAZON IS THE LARGEST RAINFOREST ON EARTH.
THE OCEANS HOLD ABOUT 97 PERCENT OF EARTH'S WATER.
EARTH SPINS AT ABOUT 1,000 MILES PER HOUR AT THE EQUATOR.
EARTH TRAVELS AROUND THE SUN AT ABOUT 67,000 MILES PER HOUR.
THE PARIS CLIMATE AGREEMENT WAS OPENED FOR SIGNING ON EARTH DAY 2016.
ARBOR DAY, A DAY FOR PLANTING TREES, BEGAN IN NEBRASKA IN 1872.
THE RECYCLING SYMBOL WAS DESIGNED BY A COLLEGE STUDENT, GARY ANDERSON, IN 1970.
cinco_de_mayo: CINCO DE MAYO MARKS MEXICO'S VICTORY OVER FRANCE AT THE BATTLE OF PUEBLA IN 1862.
CINCO DE MAYO IS NOT MEXICO'S INDEPENDENCE DAY. THAT IS SEPTEMBER 16.
GENERAL IGNACIO ZARAGOZA LED THE MEXICAN ARMY AT PUEBLA.
GENERAL ZARAGOZA WAS BORN IN WHAT IS NOW GOLIAD, TEXAS.
THE MEXICAN ARMY AT PUEBLA WAS OUTNUMBERED AND BEAT ONE OF THE WORLD'S BEST ARMIES.
"CINCO DE MAYO" IS SPANISH FOR "FIFTH OF MAY."
IN MEXICO, THE DAY IS CELEBRATED MOSTLY IN THE STATE OF PUEBLA.
THE CITY OF PUEBLA RE-ENACTS THE BATTLE EVERY YEAR.
MEXICAN AMERICANS IN CALIFORNIA BEGAN CELEBRATING CINCO DE MAYO IN THE 1860S.
MOLE POBLANO, A RICH SAUCE MADE WITH CHILES AND CHOCOLATE, COMES FROM PUEBLA.
MARIACHI MUSIC COMES FROM THE MEXICAN STATE OF JALISCO.
THE GREEN, WHITE AND RED MEXICAN FLAG SHOWS AN EAGLE ON A CACTUS HOLDING A SNAKE.
A TRADITIONAL STAR PINATA HAS SEVEN POINTS.
THE BATTLE OF PUEBLA LASTED LESS THAN A DAY.
FRANCE CAME BACK AND TOOK PUEBLA A YEAR LATER, BUT MEXICO WON IN THE END IN 1867.
THE CITY OF PUEBLA'S FULL NAME HONORS THE GENERAL: PUEBLA DE ZARAGOZA.
THE WORDS AVOCADO, TOMATO AND CHOCOLATE ALL COME FROM NAHUATL, THE AZTEC LANGUAGE.
mothers_day: ANNA JARVIS HELD THE FIRST MOTHER'S DAY SERVICE IN GRAFTON, WEST VIRGINIA IN 1908.
PRESIDENT WOODROW WILSON MADE MOTHER'S DAY A NATIONAL HOLIDAY IN 1914.
IN THE U.S., MOTHER'S DAY IS ALWAYS THE SECOND SUNDAY IN MAY.
ANNA JARVIS CHOSE THE WHITE CARNATION, HER MOTHER'S FAVORITE FLOWER, AS THE SYMBOL.
ANNA JARVIS INSISTED ON "MOTHER'S" - ONE MOTHER, YOUR OWN - NOT "MOTHERS'."
ANNA JARVIS LATER FOUGHT AGAINST THE SELLING OF MOTHER'S DAY CARDS AND CANDY.
JULIA WARD HOWE CALLED FOR A MOTHERS' DAY FOR PEACE BACK IN 1870.
IN BRITAIN, MOTHERING SUNDAY FALLS ON THE FOURTH SUNDAY OF LENT.
MOTHER'S DAY IS ONE OF THE BUSIEST DAYS OF THE YEAR FOR PHONE CALLS.
MOTHER'S DAY IS ONE OF THE BUSIEST DAYS OF THE YEAR FOR RESTAURANTS.
THE WORD FOR MOTHER STARTS WITH AN "M" SOUND IN MANY OF THE WORLD'S LANGUAGES.
A MOTHER HEN CLUCKS TO HER CHICKS BEFORE THEY EVEN HATCH.
ELEPHANT MOTHERS CARRY THEIR BABIES FOR ABOUT 22 MONTHS.
AN ORANGUTAN MOTHER STAYS WITH HER YOUNG FOR SIX YEARS OR MORE.
EMPEROR PENGUIN MOTHERS WALK UP TO 50 MILES TO THE SEA TO BRING BACK FOOD.
THE TEN COMMANDMENTS SAY, "HONOUR THY FATHER AND THY MOTHER."
A KANGAROO MOTHER CARRIES HER JOEY IN HER POUCH FOR MORE THAN SIX MONTHS.
fathers_day: SONORA SMART DODD OF SPOKANE, WASHINGTON STARTED FATHER'S DAY IN 1910.
SONORA DODD WANTED TO HONOR HER FATHER, A CIVIL WAR VETERAN WHO RAISED SIX CHILDREN.
THE FIRST FATHER'S DAY WAS CELEBRATED ON JUNE 19, 1910.
PRESIDENT NIXON SIGNED FATHER'S DAY INTO LAW IN 1972.
IN THE U.S., FATHER'S DAY IS ALWAYS THE THIRD SUNDAY IN JUNE.
THE ROSE IS THE FATHER'S DAY FLOWER - RED FOR A LIVING FATHER, WHITE IN REMEMBRANCE.
A MALE SEAHORSE CARRIES THE EGGS AND GIVES BIRTH TO THE BABIES.
EMPEROR PENGUIN FATHERS BALANCE THE EGG ON THEIR FEET FOR ABOUT TWO MONTHS.
KEN GRIFFEY SR. AND KEN GRIFFEY JR. HIT BACK-TO-BACK HOME RUNS IN 1990.
IN 1990, THE GRIFFEYS BECAME THE FIRST FATHER AND SON TO PLAY AS MLB TEAMMATES.
JIM BUNNING PITCHED A PERFECT GAME ON FATHER'S DAY, JUNE 21, 1964.
NECKTIES ARE THE CLASSIC FATHER'S DAY GIFT.
IN GERMANY, FATHER'S DAY IS CELEBRATED ON ASCENSION DAY, A THURSDAY IN SPRING.
IN SPAIN, ITALY AND PORTUGAL, FATHER'S DAY IS MARCH 19, THE FEAST OF ST. JOSEPH.
THE WORD "DAD" HAS BEEN USED IN ENGLISH SINCE AT LEAST THE 1500S.
GEORGE WASHINGTON IS CALLED THE FATHER OF HIS COUNTRY.
A MALE RHEA, A LARGE SOUTH AMERICAN BIRD, HATCHES THE EGGS AND RAISES THE CHICKS.
PROVERBS 20:7 - "THE JUST MAN WALKETH IN HIS INTEGRITY: HIS CHILDREN ARE BLESSED AFTER HIM."
independence_day: THE CONTINENTAL CONGRESS VOTED FOR INDEPENDENCE ON JULY 2, 1776.
THE DECLARATION OF INDEPENDENCE WAS ADOPTED ON JULY 4, 1776.
THOMAS JEFFERSON WROTE THE FIRST DRAFT OF THE DECLARATION AT AGE 33.
56 MEN SIGNED THE DECLARATION OF INDEPENDENCE.
MOST OF THE SIGNERS PUT THEIR NAMES ON THE DECLARATION ON AUGUST 2, 1776.
JOHN HANCOCK'S SIGNATURE IS THE LARGEST ON THE DECLARATION.
JOHN ADAMS AND THOMAS JEFFERSON BOTH DIED ON JULY 4, 1826 - 50 YEARS TO THE DAY.
PRESIDENT JAMES MONROE ALSO DIED ON JULY 4, IN 1831.
PRESIDENT CALVIN COOLIDGE WAS BORN ON JULY 4, 1872.
BENJAMIN FRANKLIN WAS THE OLDEST SIGNER, AT 70.
THE FIRST U.S. FLAG HAD 13 STARS AND 13 STRIPES.
THE 50-STAR FLAG FIRST FLEW ON JULY 4, 1960, AFTER HAWAII BECAME A STATE.
THE LIBERTY BELL IS TAPPED 13 TIMES EVERY JULY 4.
JOHN ADAMS PREDICTED THE DAY WOULD BE MARKED WITH "BONFIRES AND ILLUMINATIONS."
PHILADELPHIA HELD THE FIRST ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION, WITH FIREWORKS, IN 1777.
THE DECLARATION IS KEPT AT THE NATIONAL ARCHIVES IN WASHINGTON, D.C.
"THE STAR-SPANGLED BANNER" BECAME THE NATIONAL ANTHEM IN 1931.
LOU GEHRIG GAVE HIS "LUCKIEST MAN" SPEECH AT YANKEE STADIUM ON JULY 4, 1939.
halloween: HALLOWEEN GREW OUT OF SAMHAIN, AN ANCIENT CELTIC FESTIVAL AT SUMMER'S END.
"HALLOWEEN" IS SHORT FOR "ALL HALLOWS' EVE," THE NIGHT BEFORE ALL SAINTS' DAY.
THE FIRST JACK-O'-LANTERNS WERE CARVED FROM TURNIPS IN IRELAND.
ILLINOIS GROWS MORE PUMPKINS THAN ANY OTHER STATE.
MORTON, ILLINOIS CALLS ITSELF THE PUMPKIN CAPITAL OF THE WORLD.
CANDY CORN WAS INVENTED IN THE 1880S AND WAS ONCE CALLED "CHICKEN FEED."
A PUMPKIN IS A FRUIT, NOT A VEGETABLE.
BATS ARE THE ONLY MAMMALS THAT CAN TRULY FLY.
MOST BATS EAT INSECTS. ONE BAT CAN CATCH HUNDREDS IN AN HOUR.
THE FEAR OF HALLOWEEN IS CALLED SAMHAINOPHOBIA.
ORANGE AND BLACK STAND FOR THE FALL HARVEST AND THE DARK OF NIGHT.
ORSON WELLES' RADIO PLAY "THE WAR OF THE WORLDS" AIRED THE NIGHT BEFORE HALLOWEEN 1938.
HARRY HOUDINI DIED ON HALLOWEEN IN 1926.
TRICK-OR-TREATING BECAME POPULAR ACROSS AMERICA IN THE 1930S AND 1940S.
IN SCOTLAND AND IRELAND, DRESSING UP AND GOING DOOR TO DOOR IS CALLED "GUISING."
A GROUP OF BATS IS CALLED A COLONY. A GROUP OF WITCHES IS CALLED A COVEN.
"IT'S THE GREAT PUMPKIN, CHARLIE BROWN" FIRST AIRED IN 1966.
THE WORD "WITCH" COMES FROM AN OLD ENGLISH WORD, "WICCE."
thanksgiving: THE PILGRIMS AND THE WAMPANOAG SHARED A THREE-DAY HARVEST FEAST IN 1621.
ABOUT 90 WAMPANOAG MEN JOINED ABOUT 50 PILGRIMS AT THE 1621 FEAST.
THE MAYFLOWER CARRIED 102 PASSENGERS ACROSS THE ATLANTIC IN 1620.
PRESIDENT LINCOLN MADE THANKSGIVING A NATIONAL HOLIDAY IN 1863.
SARAH JOSEPHA HALE, AUTHOR OF "MARY HAD A LITTLE LAMB," CAMPAIGNED FOR THE HOLIDAY.
CONGRESS FIXED THANKSGIVING ON THE FOURTH THURSDAY OF NOVEMBER IN 1941.
THE MACY'S THANKSGIVING DAY PARADE BEGAN IN 1924.
THE FIRST MACY'S PARADE HAD LIVE ANIMALS FROM THE CENTRAL PARK ZOO.
THE DETROIT LIONS PLAYED THEIR FIRST THANKSGIVING GAME IN 1934 - AGAINST THE BEARS.
ONLY MALE TURKEYS GOBBLE. HENS CLUCK AND PURR.
WILD TURKEYS CAN FLY IN SHORT, FAST BURSTS. FARM TURKEYS CANNOT.
THE RED SKIN THAT HANGS OVER A TURKEY'S BEAK IS CALLED A SNOOD.
THE FLAP UNDER A TURKEY'S CHIN IS CALLED A WATTLE.
BENJAMIN FRANKLIN CALLED THE TURKEY "A MUCH MORE RESPECTABLE BIRD" THAN THE EAGLE.
CRANBERRIES, BLUEBERRIES AND CONCORD GRAPES ARE ALL NATIVE TO NORTH AMERICA.
CANADA CELEBRATES THANKSGIVING ON THE SECOND MONDAY OF OCTOBER.
PRESIDENT GEORGE H.W. BUSH GAVE THE FIRST OFFICIAL TURKEY PARDON IN 1989.
christmas_eve: JOSEPH AND MARY TRAVELED FROM NAZARETH TO BETHLEHEM, A JOURNEY OF ABOUT 90 MILES.
BETHLEHEM MEANS "HOUSE OF BREAD" IN HEBREW.
THE PROPHET MICAH FORETOLD THAT A RULER WOULD COME FROM BETHLEHEM.
MARY LAID JESUS IN A MANGER BECAUSE THERE WAS NO ROOM IN THE INN.
A MANGER IS A FEEDING TROUGH FOR ANIMALS.
AN ANGEL BROUGHT SHEPHERDS IN THE FIELDS "GOOD TIDINGS OF GREAT JOY."
THE SHEPHERDS WERE THE FIRST TO VISIT THE NEWBORN JESUS.
ISAIAH 9:6 - "FOR UNTO US A CHILD IS BORN, UNTO US A SON IS GIVEN."
THE NAME EMMANUEL MEANS "GOD WITH US."
THE GOSPEL OF LUKE, CHAPTER 2, TELLS THE STORY OF THE FIRST CHRISTMAS NIGHT.
"SILENT NIGHT" WAS FIRST SUNG ON CHRISTMAS EVE 1818 IN OBERNDORF, AUSTRIA.
"SILENT NIGHT" WAS FIRST PLAYED ON A GUITAR.
ST. FRANCIS OF ASSISI SET UP THE FIRST LIVE NATIVITY SCENE IN 1223.
ON CHRISTMAS EVE 1968, THE APOLLO 8 CREW READ FROM GENESIS WHILE ORBITING THE MOON.
ON CHRISTMAS EVE 1914, SOLDIERS IN WORLD WAR I STOPPED FIGHTING AND SANG CAROLS.
THE POEM "'TWAS THE NIGHT BEFORE CHRISTMAS" WAS FIRST PUBLISHED IN 1823.
U.S. AIR DEFENSE HAS TRACKED SANTA'S SLEIGH EVERY CHRISTMAS EVE SINCE 1955.
MANY CHURCHES HOLD A CANDLELIGHT SERVICE AT MIDNIGHT ON CHRISTMAS EVE.
christmas: RUDOLPH THE RED-NOSED REINDEER WAS CREATED IN 1939 FOR MONTGOMERY WARD OF CHICAGO.
"JINGLE BELLS" WAS PUBLISHED IN 1857 UNDER THE TITLE "ONE HORSE OPEN SLEIGH."
"JINGLE BELLS" WAS THE FIRST SONG BROADCAST FROM SPACE, IN 1965.
THE REAL ST. NICHOLAS WAS A BISHOP IN MYRA, IN WHAT IS NOW TURKEY, IN THE 300S.
THE CANDY CANE'S SHAPE IS SAID TO RECALL A SHEPHERD'S CROOK.
CHRISTMAS BECAME A U.S. FEDERAL HOLIDAY IN 1870.
THE POINSETTIA IS NAMED FOR JOEL POINSETT, WHO BROUGHT IT FROM MEXICO IN THE 1820S.
THE FIRST CHRISTMAS CARD WAS SOLD IN LONDON IN 1843.
CHARLES DICKENS PUBLISHED "A CHRISTMAS CAROL" IN 1843.
THE ROCKEFELLER CENTER TREE TRADITION BEGAN IN 1931.
THE WISE MEN BROUGHT GOLD, FRANKINCENSE AND MYRRH.
THE BIBLE NEVER SAYS HOW MANY WISE MEN THERE WERE.
THE 12 DAYS OF CHRISTMAS BEGIN ON DECEMBER 25 AND RUN TO JANUARY 5.
"WHITE CHRISTMAS" BY BING CROSBY IS THE BEST-SELLING SINGLE OF ALL TIME.
THE CUSTOM OF THE DECORATED CHRISTMAS TREE BEGAN IN GERMANY.
PRINCE ALBERT HELPED MAKE THE CHRISTMAS TREE POPULAR IN BRITAIN IN THE 1840S.
"A CHARLIE BROWN CHRISTMAS" FIRST AIRED IN 1965.
EDWARD JOHNSON, A FRIEND OF THOMAS EDISON, LIT THE FIRST ELECTRIC TREE LIGHTS IN 1882.
new_years_eve: THE TIMES SQUARE BALL FIRST DROPPED ON DECEMBER 31, 1907.
THE FIRST TIMES SQUARE BALL WAS MADE OF IRON AND WOOD AND LIT BY 100 LIGHT BULBS.
TIME BALLS WERE ONCE DROPPED IN HARBORS SO SHIPS COULD SET THEIR CLOCKS.
THE TIMES SQUARE BALL DID NOT DROP IN 1942 AND 1943 BECAUSE OF WARTIME BLACKOUTS.
IN SCOTLAND, NEW YEAR'S EVE IS CALLED HOGMANAY.
IN DENMARK, PEOPLE JUMP OFF CHAIRS AT MIDNIGHT TO "LEAP" INTO THE NEW YEAR.
IN THE PHILIPPINES, ROUND FRUITS AND POLKA DOTS ARE THOUGHT TO BRING PROSPERITY.
SYDNEY, AUSTRALIA RINGS IN THE NEW YEAR 17 HOURS BEFORE CHICAGO DOES.
GUY LOMBARDO AND HIS BAND MADE "AULD LANG SYNE" A NEW YEAR'S EVE TRADITION.
DICK CLARK'S "NEW YEAR'S ROCKIN' EVE" FIRST AIRED ON DECEMBER 31, 1972.
DECEMBER 31 IS THE FEAST OF ST. SYLVESTER. MANY COUNTRIES CALL THE NIGHT "SILVESTER."
A LEAP SECOND HAS SOMETIMES BEEN ADDED TO THE CLOCK JUST BEFORE MIDNIGHT ON DECEMBER 31.
IN JAPAN, FAMILIES EAT LONG SOBA NOODLES ON NEW YEAR'S EVE FOR A LONG LIFE.
IN ECUADOR, PEOPLE BURN LIFE-SIZE DOLLS AT MIDNIGHT TO SAY GOODBYE TO THE OLD YEAR.
MANY CHURCHES HOLD A "WATCH NIGHT" SERVICE TO PRAY IN THE NEW YEAR.
IN BRAZIL, PEOPLE WEAR WHITE ON NEW YEAR'S EVE FOR GOOD LUCK.
CHICAGO RINGS IN THE NEW YEAR ONE HOUR AFTER NEW YORK.
